newsitem.title: USA: MCI starts local service in Portland, Ore.
newsitem.headline: MCI starts local service in Portland, Ore.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said it introduced local telephone service for businesses in and around Portland.
In a statement, the company said the move represents MCI's first step in challenging US West Inc's control of the city's local telephone market.

In addition to Portland, MCI's local service will be available in the following area communities -- Beaverton, Forest Grove, Gresham, Hillsboro, Lake Oswego, Milwaukie, Oregon City, Scholls, Sherwood, Stafford and Tigard.
